tagging_guidelines: These guidelines apply to human and AI actors tagging Freshservice tickets. Knowledge review adds AI after an explicit resolution or timeout outcome; triage alone does not require it. Human actors should use AI only when AI processing occurred. Preserve existing tags and avoid duplicates. Prefer existing tags that accurately describe the ticket. If no suitable existing tag is available, use a meaningful, nonblank new tag. Use resolved when resolution has been explicitly confirmed, or timeout when the confirmation window has elapsed without confirmation. Never use resolved and timeout together, and do not apply either during triage before an explicit outcome. A timeout does not prove that the issue was resolved. Add KB Update Recommendation after a Freshservice KB recommendation has been saved as a private note. Add Dependency Map Update Recommendation after a dependency-map recommendation has been saved as a Confluence draft. Check the ticket outcome and saved recommendations before choosing these tags.
